definitionBean.title: Cube and Cuboid
definitionBean.definition: A cube is a solid whose all sides are equal, whereas in a cuboid, length, breadth and height can be different.
definitionBean.explanation: Total surface area of a cube = 6a², Volume = a³ (where a is side). Total surface area of a cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl), Volume = l × b × h.
importantPoints: Cuboid: Surface area = 2(lb + bh + hl), Volume = lbh
Cube is a special case of cuboid when l = b = h

parts.statement: Two cubes each of volume 64 cm³ are joined end to end. Find the surface area of the resulting cuboid.
parts.explanation:
Given: Volume of each cube = 64 cm³
Let the side of the cube be a.
a³ = 64 => a = 4 cm

When two such cubes are joined together, a cuboid is formed whose dimensions will be:
Length (l) = 4 + 4 = 8 cm
Breadth (b) = 4 cm
Height (h) = 4 cm

Total surface area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl)
= 2(8 × 4 + 4 × 4 + 4 × 8)
= 2(32 + 16 + 32)
= 2(80) = 160 cm²
Therefore, the surface area of the resulting cuboid is 160 cm².

parts.statement: A toy is in the form of a cone of radius 3.5 cm mounted on a hemisphere of same radius. The total height of the toy is 15.5 cm. Find the total surface area of the toy. (Use π = 22/7)
parts.explanation:
Given:
Total height of toy = 15.5 cm
Radius of hemisphere (r) = 3.5 cm
Height of cone (h) = Total height - Radius of hemisphere = 15.5 - 3.5 = 12 cm

Slant height of cone (l):
l = √(r² + h²) = √((3.5)² + 12²) = √(12.25 + 144) = √156.25 = 12.5 cm

Total surface area of toy = CSA of cone + CSA of hemisphere
= πrl + 2πr²
= πr(l + 2r)
= (22 / 7) × 3.5 × (12.5 + 2 × 3.5)
= (22 / 7) × (7 / 2) × (12.5 + 7)
= 11 × 19.5 = 214.5 cm²
Therefore, the total surface area of the toy is 214.5 cm².
